evidence.name: Screen field: Item image look
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Item image look" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Item image look
sections.description: Size and look of each item's image — width, height, corner radius, padding, and how it fits its box (fit shows the whole image with possible empty space; fill crops to cover the box). Keep a consistent size and small radius so cards look uniform; choose fill for photos and fit for logos or icons you don't want cropped. Only appears when the layout includes an image.
